---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
hr_by_season <- Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(
    total_home_runs = sum(HR),
    total_team_games = sum(G),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    home_runs_per_game = total_home_runs / total_team_games
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(hr_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs_per_game)) +
  geom_line()
```

## Career home run leaders

```{r}
career_hr_leaders <- Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarize(
    career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_season = min(yearID),
    last_season = max(yearID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  inner_join(People, by = "playerID") |>
  mutate(
    player = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    seasons = paste(first_season, last_season, sep = "-")
  ) |>
  slice_max(career_home_runs, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  select(player, career_home_runs, seasons)

knitr::kable(
  career_hr_leaders,
  col.names = c("Player", "Career home runs", "Seasons"),
  caption = "Top 10 career home run leaders"
)
```
